scope: Theorem 1.3 (Reduction to smooth canonical nonvanishing) of the manuscript “Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint” (preprints/Lifting-sections-from-the-reduced-support-of-an-adjoint-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ecbc1b8c73fefb32), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume that every smooth connected projective complex variety W with pseudo-effective KW , in every dimension, has a nonzero section of mKW for some m > 0. Let (X, ∆) be a normal projective log canonical pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, with ∆ an effective rational boundary and D = KX + ∆ a nef Q-Cartier divisor. Then D is semiample.
